UGA.note: No count or share of people enrolled given.

facts.fact: NIRA's executive director said NIRA began an information-exchange module on 31 March 2026 and onboards partners onto its new production system as they become ready, MTN first.

UGA.note: Only banks, telecoms and driving permits named as partners, not public registers keyed on the number.

facts.fact: NIRA has issued new national identity cards, which remain inactive for SIM registration, banking and driving permits until partners connect, per a COSASE hearing on 9 September 2026.
